subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 grouped action upgrades be approved together after a current-main refresh, including the token-minting, Codex-agent, CodeQL, and Docker publishing revisions?
rationale: These revisions execute with privileged permissions or secrets, and the protected `security` label requires explicit human ownership even though no concrete patch defect was found.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, confirm the official immutable SHAs, and merge the grouped update after the relevant workflow gates pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker publishing updates from routine language and maintenance actions for narrower validation and rollback.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until release and secret-bearing workflow validation can be completed with the desired confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, confirm the official immutable SHAs, and merge the grouped update after the relevant workflow gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the repeated CI and repository-wide action-runtime modernization work on these workflows.
